name: Himmapan Bloodlines
tagline: Thai myth heroes. Hold the lane. Go giant.
description: A Thai-mythology card lane-defense game. Thirty young Bangkok heroes who carry Himmapan bloodlines fight across three lanes, then transform into giant mythic creatures: Naga, Singha, Krut and more. Six elements, Duo Strikes and three-phase giant bosses. Free to play with no ads and nothing random for sale. Coming 2027 to the App Store.
tags: No ads, nothing random for sale

name: Titan Legends
description: A bright 3D kaiju action game for ages 6 and up. Play a cute-but-mighty Titan, stomp through tiny towns and toy armies, pick skill cards to evolve your powers, turn GIANT and topple huge bosses across 12 wild lands. Pay once (USD 9.99): no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: Cadence
tagline: The habit tracker that forgives you.
description: A habit tracker built on weekly goals instead of daily streaks. Missing a day doesn't reset your progress. Free tier keeps 10 habits with the full app working; Cadence Pro is a one-time lifetime purchase, no subscription required. Fully offline-capable.

name: SoulSync AI
description: An AI relationship advisor that combines real Eastern metaphysics — Bazi (Four Pillars) and Zi Wei Dou Shu — with Western astrology, then uses AI coaching to explain the compatibility, dynamics and future potential of a relationship in plain language. Reads romantic partners, friendships, business partners and family.
